slides.texte_overlay:
signs your brain needs a
reset (and how to give it one)

you reread the same line

when you read the same sentence three times, your focus is spent. step away for ten minutes, ideally outside, before you try to push through it again.

everything feels urgent

when every small task feels like an emergency, your brain is overloaded. write everything down, pick the one thing that matters, and let the rest wait an hour.

you can't sit still

if you can't sit through one episode without your phone, your brain is craving quick hits. one boring evening without screens resets more than you'd ever expect.

nothing feels interesting

when nothing feels interesting anymore, feed your mind something new: 5 minutes a day on a strange fact, a painting, a moment in history. curiosity is the first thing to come back.

slides.texte_overlay:
your sleep feels light

when you wake up tired after a full night, your brain is still running. cut screens an hour before bed for a week and watch how much deeper your sleep becomes.
